department: Pharmaceutical Sciences (Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences)

deadline.value: The catalog page gives no application deadline.

entry_route.value: External applicants are accepted with a master's in pharmaceutical sciences with a 3.5 GPA or better; UMass Lowell master's students can advance directly.
entry_route.quote: External applicants to the PhD program will be accepted if they have a MS degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences with a cumulative GPS of 3.5 or greater from another college or university

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog page does not describe PhD funding.

notes: Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences; its own English and GRE rules were not found on the catalog page, so the graduate-school rules apply by default. Not a Kennedy or engineering program.
